author: Karen Van Hamme
text: That’s happened to me before. Blood squirted out of the little hole and sprayed across the bathroom mirror.  It looked like a murder scene.  Abbott says that just happens sometimes. It’s not user error.  No worries.

author: Helen Coyle Rose
text: I’m wondering if Gene Holcombe has shares in Abbott. Admin need to remove this rude, nasty man.
